require: хотя бы два обстоятельства или одно сложное придаточное

patterns.generation_hint: Подчеркни длительность и результат. Используй for/since для точности.
examples: I have been working on a strategic initiative for the marketing department since last Monday, and I think I am finally making progress.
She has been studying English for more than five years, so she feels much more confident in real conversations now.

topics.topic: Past Perfect vs Past Perfect Continuous

patterns.pattern: [S] + had + [V3] + [complex object] + before + [S] + [V2], but + [S] + had been + [V-ing] + for + [time]
patterns.generation_hint: Покажи разницу: Past Perfect — завершённое действие до другого, Past Perfect Continuous — длительность до момента.
examples: I had finished the strategic plan before the client called, but I had been working on it for more than two weeks.
She had completed the report before the meeting started, but she had been preparing it since Monday morning.

patterns.pattern: This time next week, [S] + will be + [V-ing] + [complex object] + [optional: place]
patterns.generation_hint: Используй Future Continuous для действий в процессе в конкретный момент будущего.
examples: This time next week, I will be travelling through South-East Asia.
This time next month, she will be working on a new project at the company's main office.
This time tomorrow, they will be attending an international conference in Berlin.

patterns.pattern: By + [future time], [S] + will have + [V3] + [complex object] + [optional: result]
patterns.generation_hint: Используй Future Perfect для действий, которые завершатся к определённому моменту.
examples: By next Friday, I will have completed all the assignments for the certification in project management.
By the end of the year, she will have finished her postgraduate course and opened up new opportunities for herself.
By 2027, they will have implemented the long-term plan for the company's development.

subtopics.name: must have / might have / can't have + V3

patterns.generation_hint: Используй модальные перфекты для догадок о прошлом. must — уверен, might — возможно, can't — не может быть.
examples: She must have misunderstood the client's message because she sent the wrong document.
They can't have received the meeting details because they arrived completely unprepared.
He might have forgotten the deadline because he looked very stressed when I asked him.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй causative, когда действие выполняет кто-то другой, а не сам субъект.
examples: I had my CV reviewed by a professional consultant before applying for the job.
She got the office renovated by a team of local craftsmen last month.
They had the website redesigned because the old version was too complicated.

patterns.pattern: If + [S] + had + [V3] + [complex object], [S] + would have + [V3] + [complex object] + [optional: result]
patterns.generation_hint: Опиши нереальную ситуацию в прошлом и её гипотетический результат.

complex object (condition): the offer when it was on the table

examples: If I had read the client's requirements carefully, I would have avoided all the issues we had.
If she had got her priorities right, she would have completed the whole project on time and everything would have gone smoothly.
If they had acted on the offer when it was on the table, they would have got the contract with the investor.

patterns.pattern: If + [S] + had + [V3] + [complex object], [S] + would + [V1] + [complex object] + now
patterns.generation_hint: Смешанный conditional: условие в прошлом, результат в настоящем.
examples: If I had got the certification in project management, I would have a much higher salary now.
If she had taken the opportunity to work abroad, she would be working in a completely different role now.
If they had done the language course last year, they would communicate with international clients fluently now.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй wish + Past Simple для сожалений о настоящем.

complex object: more free time during the week
a bigger flat in the city centre

examples: I wish I had more free time during the week, but my schedule is completely full.
She wishes she knew how to solve this problem, but it's more complicated than she expected.
They wish they had a better work-life balance, but their jobs are very demanding.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй wish + Past Perfect для сожалений о прошлом.

complex object: the offer when I had the chance

examples: I wish I had taken the offer when I had the chance, but I was too afraid of change.
She wishes she had done the language course last year, because now she feels less confident at work.
They wish they had read the client's requirements more carefully, because they lost the contract.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй Present Perfect Passive для результата, важного сейчас.
examples: The project has been implemented by the whole team recently, and the first results look promising.
All the documents have been reviewed by the research department, so we are ready for the audit.
The new system has been streamlined by a team of experts this month.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй Future Passive для будущих событий, где важен процесс.
examples: The new office will be opened by the board of directors next month.
The results will be announced by the committee responsible for the project at the end of the year.
The presentation will be prepared by the marketing team before the conference.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй модальный пассив для рекомендаций, возможностей и обязательств.
examples: The proposal should be reviewed by the committee before we make a final decision.
All the applications must be submitted by the end of the week because the deadline is strict.
The report can be prepared by the research department without any additional support.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй разные reporting verbs для передачи чужой речи.
examples: He explained that he had completed the strategic plan before the deadline because the client was waiting.
She admitted that she had misunderstood the client's requirements, and promised to fix everything.
The manager emphasized that we had done a great job on the international project.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй non-defining relative clauses для дополнительной информации. Запятые обязательны.

complex object: me the most in my career

examples: My manager, who supported me the most in my career, has become one of my closest mentors, and I will always be grateful to him.
This book, which changed my way of thinking, is called 'Atomic Habits', and I often recommend it to others.
The project, which impressed everyone at the meeting, has become a turning point for our company.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй linking words для связи идей в тексте: however, therefore, nevertheless, consequently.
examples: Our team works on several international projects. However, we still need to improve our communication with the client because the deadlines are getting tighter.
The company invests in new technology. Therefore, it develops innovative solutions for the market.
She studies hard and practices every day. Nevertheless, she still needs more confidence in real conversations.

subtopics.name: Linking Verbs (seem, appear, become, turn out)

patterns.generation_hint: Используй linking verbs для описания состояний и изменений.
examples: This approach seems very effective because it saves us a lot of time.
The new system appears quite complicated, but it turns out to be very useful in practice.
The situation remains challenging, but the results have become a real breakthrough for the team.
